feeds.title: SpunOut
feeds.description: SpunOut. is Ireland's youth information website created by young people, for young people. We aim to educate and inform our readers about the importance of holistic wellbeing and how good health can be maintained, both physically and mentally.

feeds.title: Mental Health Ireland Blog
feeds.description: At Mental Health Ireland, they seek to advance good mental health and wellness for all people and communities and to aid those who have actually experienced mental health difficulties in their recovery, giving concrete form to national policy goals. They have development officers spread out over the nation that connects with the network of mental health associations, volunteers, and community organizations, promoting mental health and aiding recovery in local neighborhoods. Browse through their blog about the latest news, services, programs, webinars, resources, and more.

feeds.title: Irish Medical Times
feeds.description: Irish Medical Times is the original newspaper for Irish doctors, with breaking health news, insightful analysis and clinical reports, and controversial opinions. IMT's mission is to deliver quality, up-to-date news, features, special reports, and interviews for Ireland's medical professionals

feeds.title: Aware Blog
feeds.description: Aware is the national organization providing free support, education, and information services to those impacted by anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, and related mood conditions.

feeds.title: Health Care Informed (HCI) Blog
feeds.description: HCI is a professional services provider of patient safety, regulatory compliance, and quality improvement intelligence and support to health and social care organizations. Our philosophy is based on delivering a value-added quality and safety service to the organizations we work with.

feeds.title: The College of Psychiatrists of Ireland Blog
feeds.description: College of Psychiatrists (Ireland) is the professional body for psychiatrists, promoting best standards of practice & care in Irish mental health services. The Mission of the College is to promote excellence in the practice of psychiatry.

feeds.title: Grow Mental Health
feeds.description: Grow Mental Health Podcast is about the Free Mental Health Support in Ireland.

feeds.title: LINDA M COWAN Blog
feeds.description: Seasoned counselor, published author, and influential YouTuber Linda M Cowan is passionate about Health and Wellness, and dedicated to helping others achieve mental and physical well-being. Explore a treasure trove of knowledge and inspiration, where every article is crafted to educate, motivate, and uplift viewers in their pursuit of health and wellness.

feeds.title: The DMC Clinic Blog
feeds.description: At The DMC Clinic, we are a team of Fully Qualified and Accredited Counsellors, Psychotherapists and Trainee Counsellors providing counselling and psychotherapy to children, teenagers and adults in the Wexford Community.

feeds.title: Keelings
feeds.description: At Keelings we are passionate about what we do and we want your family to share our passion for fresh fruits of outstanding quality. We share health and nutritional information through our blog, recipes that are both healthy and indulgent.

feeds.title: Health by Orla Blog
feeds.description: At Health by Orla, we identify and support the root cause of the issue. We empower you to transform your health by knowing the right nutrients for them. Our approach to nutrition is personalized to each individual, using comprehensive biomedical testing to get to the root cause of symptoms and support each person according to their results.

feeds.title: SilverCloud Health Blog
feeds.description: SilverCloud Health provides accessible, scalable, digital behavioral healthcare. Read SilverCloud's latest articles about cognitive behavioral health and mental health news and use the search function to find specific posts.

feeds.title: SeeChange Blog
feeds.description: SeeChange organization is dedicated to reducing the stigma associated with mental health problems and challenging discrimination. To create an environment where people are more open and positive in their attitudes and behavior towards mental health.

feeds.title: Shine Blog
feeds.description: Shine is the national organisation dedicated to upholding the rights and addressing the needs of all those affected by enduring mental illness including, but not exclusively, schizophrenia, schizo-affective disorder and bi-polar disorder, through the promotion and provision of high-quality services and working to ensure the continual enhancement of the quality of life of the people it serves.

feeds.title: Webdoctor Blog
feeds.description: Helpful information on a variety of health topics for patients!At webdoctor, our mission is to provide you with the highest quality of medical care. A safe and affordable online doctor service that conveniently delivers prescriptions.

feeds.title: The Queen of Health Blog
feeds.description: The Queen of Health is one of Ireland's most well-known and respected nutritional and lifestyle coaches. The Queen of Health's holistic approach to health and lifestyle helps women lose weight, regain energy and live life to the fullest.

feeds.title: Glenville Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Glenville Nutrition specializes in male and female fertility, women's health, hormonal issues, weight loss, osteoporosis, and digestive issues. Our team are trusted nutrition experts and regular contributors to media including TV, radio and press.
